IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_doberman: A lean, watchful guard dog and the quickest study of any breed: it trains Obedience faster than even the German Shepherd. In a fight it is all edge and no armour: weak while untrained, but at full Combat skill it bites harder than any other dog in the pack, though it soaks up less punishment than a Rottweiler. Its real gift is steadiness: with your Doberman at your side your nerves settle, your firearm recoil recovers faster and you reload quicker (Steady Aim). Found guarding police stations and military checkpoints.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_SteadyAim_desc: Your Doberman is watching your back. While it is nearby, fed and loyal, your stress drains away, your aim recovers faster after each shot and you reload more quickly.
